turnaround_reason: DV de-rated from a ~$40 growth darling to ~$10 as ad-verification growth decelerated from 20%+ to high-single/low-double digits and the market punished any adtech name tied to programmatic budgets. The business itself never broke — it kept growing revenue and free cash flow — so this is a valuation reset, not an operational collapse.
bullish_points: Genuinely good business: 82% gross margins, 34% adj-EBITDA margins, $131M TTM FCF, net cash (~$174M cash vs ~$96M debt).
Still growing: Q1 2026 revenue +10% YoY, FY2026 guide reaffirmed at $810-826M (8-10% growth). Beat Q1 EPS badly ($0.17 vs $0.059 est).
Loud insider conviction: net +566k shares bought over 6 months across 18 purchase transactions, including CEO and CFO — not option-grant noise, actual accumulation.
Aggressive buyback: $100M repurchased YTD into the weakness, shrinking the float at a de-rated multiple.
Valuation is cheap for the quality: forward P/E ~8.5, EV/EBITDA ~11, P/B ~1.5. Analyst mean target $13.07 (~25% above spot) with a buy rating from 15 analysts.
bearish_points: Secular overhang: AI-driven ad platforms (Meta/Google/Amazon walled gardens) and Scibids/optimization commoditization could compress the need for third-party verification over time.
Growth has structurally slowed — the days of 20%+ are likely gone, so multiple re-rating depends on stabilization, not reacceleration.
Two consecutive quarters of small EPS estimate misses on the headline print before Q1's beat; guidance has been described as cautious.
Dossier news feed was empty (yfinance nulls), so catalyst read leans on external search rather than fresh company-specific flow.
catalyst: Q2 2026 earnings — confirmation that FY guide holds (or is raised) plus continued social/CTV attach and buyback pace would validate the floor and support re-rating.
suggested_trade: Spot position, scale in $9.50-10.50. Options are effectively untradeable here (near-zero OI), so this is an equity-only name. Add on any post-earnings dip that holds the $7.64 52w low.
key_risk: A guide cut or margin walk-back on Aug 6 that signals the growth slowdown is turning into a growth stall — that reprices it lower regardless of how cheap it looks.
would_skip_if: FY revenue guide gets cut below 8% growth, or EBITDA margin guide drops below ~32%, on the Aug 6 call.
